layout.arrangement: Red serif title centered at top with a yellow circular slide-number badge '45' at the top-right corner. Below the title, a full-width pale-yellow highlight box with blue border holds three lines of blue/red annotation text. The remaining ~65% of the slide is one large blue-bordered architecture diagram read bottom-to-top: X vector row at bottom, yellow caption strip under it, a dark-blue 'Multi Head Self Attention Block' bar, blue up-arrows, a Y vector row inside a green dashed container that also holds red '+' circles, a gray 'Layer Normalization' bar, and 8 orange curved residual arrows bowing from the Y row up to the '+' circles; above the container sit a second Y vector row, a blue-bordered 'Feed Forward Networks' box containing 8 mini network icons, and a final top Y vector row. Three two-line text labels ('Output of Self Attention' blue, 'Residual Connections' orange, 'Input to Self Attention' red) run down the left margin outside the diagram, each aligned with its corresponding diagram feature. A thin black strip spans the very bottom edge (likely captured video-player progress bar).
